question: Is a fully position-compatible, history-disjoint 64-row bank natively capable enough for a decisive frozen four-head target/P/C confirmation?
evidence_status: Prospective native-capability gate. The v22 target/P effect game is open, including the audit that invalidated its position-misaligned C panel. No v23 model outcome or intervention has been opened.

searched: all aspectual/is-was builders v1-v22 and their complete row, reporter, and text inventories
all is/was capability gates through v22
the v22 exact effect-game result and its instrument audit
prior_art.known_lessons: V22 target and P rows were valid, but its canonical C rows differed in semantic endpoint and sequence length. Absolute-position response copying therefore made C leakage and global closure inadmissible. V23 makes equality of base/donor semantic positions a builder invariant in every panel.
prior_art.novelty: All 64 row IDs, 16 reporter nouns, and every prompt are disjoint from v1-v22. Target constructions deliberately retain the v22 forms to isolate lexical replication; C is a new equal-length harbor/canyon answer-preserving control.

frozen_design.measurement: Exactly two native forwards over all 64 rows and both sides; only native next-token correctness is computed.

predictions.pred_a_authority_novelty_and_exact_popul: Builder hash, row digest, full-history row/reporter/text disjointness, construction checks, exact 16x4 inventory, and base/donor semantic-position equality pass.
predictions.pred_b_native_a_panel_capability: Every A1/A2 direction-by-side cell has native accuracy at least 0.75.
predictions.pred_c_joint_capable_population: Each A panel has at least 12 of 16 rows whose native base and donor predictions are both correct.
predictions.pred_d_no_causal_outcome_access_and_exac: Exactly two native forwards/128 examples, zero interventions/backwards/updates, and no v23 circuit outcome access.

decision: A-D pass freezes the jointly capable rows for one separately preregistered four-head singleton/union confirmation with exact aligned closure, reader-contracted Q, behavior, P, and C. Failure closes v23 without modifying rows or testing the circuit.
